content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the HPU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of HPU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HPU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The closing date for online applications is 07 September 2026. It is advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 26 vacancies for Assistant Professor posts announced by Himachal Pradesh University (HPU) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for HPU Assistant Professor jobs?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required is as per UGC Regulations, 2018, which typically includes a Master's degree and clearing the National Eligibility Test (NET) or possessing a Ph.D. as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 2000/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Professor post ranges from Rs. 57,700 to Rs. 1,82,400 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for HPU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve a screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from other states apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The notification is for Himachal Pradesh University, and candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply, provided they meet the specified criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation will be applicable for candidates belonging to reserved categories as per the government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, labeled as 'Official Notification PDF'.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for HPU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The application process for these posts is entirely online through the official website of Himachal Pradesh University.
